newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman's deputy PM for security and defence dies.
newsitem.headline: Oman's deputy PM for security and defence dies.

text.p: Oman's Deputy Prime Minister for Security and Defence Affairs Fahr bin Taimour al-Said died on Saturday, the royal court said in a statement.
It gave no further details, but official sources said they believed he had been ill for some time.
Said, 71, an uncle of Sultan Qaboos bin Said, had held the post since 1979.
He began his career in the army in 1950 after attending military academies in India and Pakistan and was a former minister of interior and of youth.
Flags on state buildings were lowered to half-mast as three days of national mourning began.
